extras: Detailed disclosure section on network usage: messages, attached notes and images, and tool-read note content are sent to the selected provider (or stay local with Ollama); the bundled LangChain library may fetch token-counting data from tiktoken.pages.dev. Edits can be reviewed before applying via a 'Review changes' setting; web search is unavailable with Ollama models; chat history files should not be modified or moved.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in AI assistant that can act on the vault by creating, editing, searching, and organizing notes on the user's behalf.
